newsitem.title: USA: Yields fall on Bond Buyer's weekly indices.
newsitem.headline: Yields fall on Bond Buyer's weekly indices.

text.p: Yields on the Bond Buyer municipal bond indices fell this week.
The yield on the 20-bond index of general obligation bonds calculated Thursday, Nov 21, was 5.55 percent, down five basis points from last Thursday.
The yield on the 11-bond index of GO bonds was 5.45 percent, also down five basis points from last Thursday.
The yield on the 30-year revenue bond index was 5.83 percent, down three basis points from last Thursday.
